name: citrus_draft_canary_ok
description: Count of `draft_canary.ok` lines from the citrus-api Cloud Run service (server/src/canary/draftCanary.ts). Every 5 minutes each API instance signs a draft token exactly as discovery does, opens wss://draft.citrusfantasysports.com/ws/draft/<canary league> and receives the engine's snapshot. It is the only signal that proves the API's token is accepted by the engine; on 2026-09-16 every other signal was green while no browser could join a draft. Managed by infra/gcp/monitoring/apply-uptime.sh.

labels.description: Cloud Run region of the instance that ran the canary.
